scope: Destiny 1 Rise of Iron PS4 terrain MainGeom0 native vertex fetch and VS parameter-export contract

vertices2.storage: little-endian int16x4 normal followed by IEEE-754 half2 UV

source_streams.index_stream: u16 triangle strip with 0xffff primitive restart

fetch_contract.native_consumer_proof: VS begins by converting the lanes with V_CVT_F32_I32; feeding float bit-patterns would be incorrect

ps4_fetch_shader_model.behavior: one 16-byte GnmBuffer descriptor is loaded from the vertex-buffer table per input semantic and buffer_load_format_x/xy/xyz/xyzw writes directly to the semantic's declared starting VGPR
ps4_fetch_shader_model.note: This establishes the descriptor/fetch mechanism independently of Destiny. Exact runtime GPU addresses are draw-time values and are not required to preserve the source-neutral import contract.

native_constant_contract.api_slot_12: view/projection matrix used for POS0; terrain PARAM exports are camera-independent

implementation.production_path: D1 packed terrain streams -> exact post-fetch words -> native VS PARAM evaluation -> neutral SourceVertexStream/ProgramVertexStage -> translated native PS -> generic renderer
implementation.ci_note: The isolated Destiny 1 importer cargo check succeeds at 60a18566. The repository's D1 workflow still stops later on a pre-existing TFX opcode 0x43 oracle test failure present before these terrain changes.

t14_boundary.established: Native terrain PS families consume resource-table T14; T14 is absent from serialized SMaterial_ROI PS texture arrays and correlates exhaustively with effective STerrain dyemaps.
corroboration: Pinned/current Charm Terrain.cs contains terrainTextureIndex = 14 and exports TerrainDyemaps.
Charm S2ShaderConverter emits g_t14 with the TerrainDyemap attribute for terrain shaders.
t14_boundary.not_yet_promoted: T14 == effective STerrain dyemap in the retail PS4 runtime
t14_boundary.reason: The retail runtime producer/write into resource-table slot 14 has not yet been independently recovered. Exporter/tooling naming is corroboration, not a native producer edge.

proof_boundary: The native terrain vertex-fetch and VS PARAM contract is closed for 80D76A8C/80D76A8D. T14 remains deliberately fail-closed until the retail runtime producer edge is independently proven.
